title: Small Changes, Big Impact: Demographic Bias in LLM-Based Hiring Through Subtle Sociocultural Markers in Anonymised Resumes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM hiring preferences (win-rates and top-score rates) for anonymised resumes containing subtle sociocultural markers (languages, volunteering, activities) associated with Chinese, Malay, Indian, and Caucasian ethnicities in the Singapore context.
Evaluating LLM hiring preferences for anonymised resumes containing job-irrelevant sociocultural markers (hobbies, co-curricular activities) stereotypically associated with Male and Female genders.

Analyzing the combined effects of race and gender on resume rankings to identify compound disadvantages, specifically examining outcomes for minority women (e.g., Malay and Indian females) versus other groups.
